author: reactive-end
summary: Release job builds Windows x64/ARM64, Linux x64 gnu/musl and ARM64, macOS ARM64/x64 with smoke tests and a macOS test run, publishes on tags and uploads artifacts on manual dry runs; install.sh/install.ps1 can install from a release with checksum verification and install.ps1 renames a running anvil.exe before copying.
evidence: bash -n OK; PowerShell parser 0 errors; ci.yml parses with PyYAML; anvil check --scope PASS; install.ps1 installed anvil 0.4.0 and renamed the old exe
